Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square 1:1 fantasy RPG inventory item illustration: Rhosyn's wine-red modest long medieval dress, exact neckline, sleeve silhouette and discreet gold tower mark from portrait. Empty wearable dress with no body.. Reference 1 defines the item's exact DESIGN, materials, colors and any authentic house emblem. Reference 2 defines the ITEM ART STYLE only: hand-painted illustrated fantasy inventory art, painterly textured metal, leather, wood and cloth, crisp dark outlines, soft simplified shading, muted warm colors, gentle illustrated highlights, readable details and a clear silhouette at small thumbnail size. Not photorealistic, not CGI or a glossy 3D render. Preserve the item's design and heraldry from reference 1; never copy the symbols or house colors of the style reference. Show the entire isolated object, centered and large within the square, with about 10% clear margin on all sides. Slight three-quarter view where appropriate; long weapons may run diagonally from lower-left handle to upper-right tip. TRUE transparent PNG alpha background; at most a very faint soft BLACK contact shadow immediately beneath the object. No person, hands, mannequin, scenery, floor, stand, frame, text, watermark or painted checkerboard. Do not add unrelated objects.
Exact requested object: Rhosyn's wine-red modest long medieval dress, exact neckline, sleeve silhouette and discreet gold tower mark from portrait. Empty wearable dress with no body.
True transparent exterior. No external shadow.
